  "title": "Unbundled consent on user registration",
  "body": "## This is a Feature Proposal \r\n\r\n\r\n* This issue is part of the GDPR EPIC #3320 \r\n\r\n\r\n#### :tophat: Description\r\n\r\nThis is a feature proposal to have a better compliance with [GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation). \r\n\r\nWe need to separate better on the user registration page what belongs to the TOS (Terms Of Service) and what belongs to the newsletter.\r\n\r\nhttps://www.econsultancy.com/blog/69253-gdpr-10-examples-of-best-practice-ux-for-obtaining-marketing-consent \r\n",
  "author": "Participant 1",
  "created_at": "2018-05-02T08:51:10Z",

  "state": "closed",
  "closed_at": null,

  ],
  "expected_comment_count": 5,
  "retrieved_comment_count": 5,
  "comments_complete": true,
  "comments": [
    {
      "id": 385993575,
      "url": "https://github.com/decidim/decidim/issues/3319#issuecomment-385993575",
      "created_at": "2018-05-02T14:18:09Z",
      "updated_at": "2018-05-08T11:23:26Z",
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "For those participants that don't tick the newsletter checkbox, now that it is a default option, I strongly suggest we add a modal when pushing the regitration button saying:\r\n\r\n\"Hey, are you sure you don't want to receive a newsletter? **Please consider again ticking the newsletter checkbox below**. It is very important for us that you can receive occasional emails to make important announcements, you can always change this on your preferences [link to preferences] (once registered). **If you don't tick the box you might be missing relevant information** about new participatory opportunities within the platform. If you still want to avoid receiving newsletters, we perfectly understand your decision. Thanks for reading this!\"\r\n\r\nUnder this modal the checkbox should appear again."
    },
    {
      "id": 386583024,
      "url": "https://github.com/decidim/decidim/issues/3319#issuecomment-386583024",
      "created_at": "2018-05-04T12:14:56Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@xabier Have somebody spell checked this text? Or if its suits GDPR?\r\n\r\nPS: [link to preferences] cannot be added because it is a link for already registered users, so it has to be only text."
    },
    {
      "id": 386657150,
      "url": "https://github.com/decidim/decidim/issues/3319#issuecomment-386657150",
      "created_at": "2018-05-04T16:34:12Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "> @xabier Have somebody spell checked this text? Or if its suits GDPR?\r\n\r\nRegarding the spell check I have modified and spell checked it right now, regarding the GDPR, I am no expert, but I don't see how it doesn't comply to GDPR, to my knowledge GDPR only forces that users need to actively select and not passively (by default) accept these options, it doesn't say you cannot insist or explain why the option is important.\r\n\r\n> PS: [link to preferences] cannot be added because it is a link for already registered users, so it has to be only text.\r\n\r\nBut the link is independent from the specific, could we not link generically to https://decidim-instance.org/notifications_settings ?"
    },
    {
      "id": 387319239,
      "url": "https://github.com/decidim/decidim/issues/3319#issuecomment-387319239",
      "created_at": "2018-05-08T08:02:00Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "Ok for the text.\r\n\r\nLet me clarify for [link to preferences]. This is a page for registered users to configure his notifications settings. This text will be shown in registration form, so not registered user yet. So, it's quite useless to add a link to a page that cannot access."
    },
    {
      "id": 387371191,

      "body": "@MarcReniu I have updated the text with \"(once registered)\""
    }
  ],
